_readme: Instruments for TAPE CHECK. Add headlines below: a headline shows on a card when its symbol matches and its date is the latest bar's date (or the day before). Keep each to one line.

instruments.name: WTI
instruments.driver: Cushing stocks, US output, and macro risk appetite. WTI is the US benchmark, delivered inland at Cushing.
instruments.source: Live: Yahoo Finance chart API (query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart). Fallback snapshot captured 2026-11-05.

instruments.name: Brent
instruments.driver: OPEC+ policy, Middle East and Russia supply risk, and Asian demand. Brent prices about two-thirds of world crude.
instruments.source: Live: Yahoo Finance chart API (query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart). Fallback snapshot captured 2026-11-05.

instruments.name: RBOB
instruments.driver: US driving demand, refinery outages and seasonal grade switches. ×42 converts $/gal to $/bbl for the crack.
instruments.source: Live: Yahoo Finance chart API (query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart). Fallback snapshot captured 2026-11-05.

instruments.name: ULSD
instruments.driver: Distillate stocks, trucking and industrial demand, winter heating, and Europe's diesel balance.
instruments.source: Live: Yahoo Finance chart API (query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart). Fallback snapshot captured 2026-11-05.

instruments.name: Henry Hub
instruments.driver: Weather (heating and cooling degree days), storage vs the 5-year average, and LNG export feedgas.
instruments.source: Live: Yahoo Finance chart API (query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart). Fallback snapshot captured 2026-11-05.

headlines.text: Example only: replace with a real headline, e.g. 'EIA: crude stocks fell 4.2M bbl vs 1.5M expected draw.'
